latest_release.name: v0.13.3
latest_release.body:
### Added

- 🦾 **Agents in automations.** The automation editor now lets you choose a terminal and working folder, then select a coding agent available there. Scheduled runs use that saved terminal and folder, and check that the terminal and agent are still available before starting. Agent automations send their results to a chat; channel destinations remain available for ordinary models. [Commit](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/commit/21fc016141c73a0e11b428c61bde20527bbc228a)
- 📂 **Change terminal and folder during a chat.** You can now choose a different terminal or working folder after sending messages, including in temporary chats. Both controls remain disabled while a reply is being generated. [Commit](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/commit/a518ff1630b74ed6edd62538c5da4bb26cc6dd20)
- 🇧🇷 **Brazilian Portuguese translations.** Added missing translations for terminal and folder controls, Git actions, spreadsheet editing, voice notes, tab shortcuts, notification sounds and tool settings. Updated the explanations for document retrieval, tool permissions and voice settings. [#33945](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/pull/33945)

### Fixed

- 📂 **Files tabs follow terminal changes.** Switching a chat to another terminal now updates its open Files tabs to show that terminal's files, instead of leaving the previous terminal's folders on screen. With a terminal set to "Per chat", the Files tab also switches to the chat's own files after the first message. [#33954](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/pull/33954)
- 🧭 **Agents in unsupported model pickers.** Connecting a terminal no longer adds its coding agents to Admin Models, base-model selectors, Arena candidates, task-model settings, group defaults, sub-agent settings, channel mentions or the Playground. Notes also stop choosing a terminal agent for title generation. Agents cannot be saved or imported as custom models or their base models, and their chat menu no longer offers Edit. [Commit](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/commit/21fc016141c73a0e11b428c61bde20527bbc228a), [Commit](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/commit/6d3123b5b4a90962bff44c69c7e0bae0c65557d5)
- 🔌 **Agent list after switching terminals.** Changing terminals immediately removes the previous terminal's agents from the chat's model list while the new list loads. A model-list request from a chat you have left can no longer replace the current list. [Commit](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/commit/21fc016141c73a0e11b428c61bde20527bbc228a)
- 📋 **Copy buttons over plain HTTP.** At a plain HTTP address on your local network, copying comment links, search links, shared-chat links, webhook URLs, chat IDs, Git branch names, commit hashes and spreadsheet cells now works. Copy Formatted Text preserves formatting, and copied text keeps its final line break. [#33939](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/pull/33939)
- 📝 **Clipboard prompts and Auto-Copy Response over plain HTTP.** Prompts using the clipboard placeholder now insert into chats and channels even when the browser blocks clipboard access, with a message explaining that the clipboard could not be read. Auto-Copy Response stays off and shows a permission message instead of silently failing to turn on; turning it off no longer requires clipboard access. [#33939](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/pull/33939)
- 🧠 **DeepSeek thinking mode with skills, knowledge and memories.** These chats no longer fail with a missing reasoning error when the connection's Provider is set to "llama.cpp". DeepSeek thinking mode still requires that setting; connections using "Default" are unchanged. [#33950](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/pull/33950)
- 🏷️ **Labels on grouped tool calls.** With Tool Call Labels enabled, a group of tool calls keeps the labels that are present even if one call has none. The unlabeled call shows its tool name instead of making the whole group lose its labels. [#33932](https://github.com/

detail.readme:
Open WebUI

Open WebUI is a home for AI: an extensible, easy-to-use, self-hosted platform built to run entirely offline. Connect local models through Ollama or use OpenAI-compatible APIs for local and cloud models.

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh.md) | [繁體中文](README.zht.md) | [한국어](README.ko.md) | [Deutsch](README.de.md) | [Español](README.es.md) | [Français](README.fr.md) | [Italiano](README.it.md) | [Dansk](README.da.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md) | [Polski](README.pl.md) | [Русский](README.ru.md) | [Bosanski](README.bs.md) | [العربية](README.ar.md) | [Norsk](README.no.md) | [Português (Brasil)](README.br.md) | [ไทย](README.th.md) | [Türkçe](README.tr.md) | [Українська](README.uk.md) | [বাংলা](README.bn.md) | [Ελληνικά](README.gr.md) | [Tiếng Việt](README.vi.md) [![Open WebUI Demo](https://cdn.openwebui.com/open-webui-demo.gif)](https://docs.openwebui.com/) ![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/open-webui/open-webui?style=social) ![GitHub forks](https://img.shields.io/github/forks/open-webui/open-webui?style=social) ![GitHub watchers](https://img.shields.io/github/watchers/open-webui/open-webui?style=social) ![GitHub repo size](https://img.shields.io/github/repo-size/open-webui/open-webui) ![GitHub language count](https://img.shields.io/github/languages/count/open-webui/open-webui) ![GitHub top language](https://img.shields.io/github/languages/top/open-webui/open-webui) ![GitHub last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/open-webui/open-webui?color=red) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Open_WebUI-blue?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/5rJgQTnV4s) [![](https://img.shields.io/static/v1?label=Sponsor&message=Support&logo=GitHub&color=%23fe8e86)](https://github.com/sponsors/open-webui) [Explore Open WebUI →](https://docs.openwebui.com/) ### Installation #### Python ```bash # With uv installed (macOS/Linux) DATA_DIR=~/.open-webui uvx --python 3.12 open-webui@latest serve # Or install and run with pip (Python 3.12) pip install open-webui open-webui serve ``` Then open [http://localhost:8080](http://localhost:8080). #### Docker ```bash docker run -d -p 3000:8080 --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -v open-webui:/app/backend/data --name open-webui --restart always ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main ``` Then open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000). | Image tag | Includes | | --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `:main` | Standard image with local AI dependencies | | `:slim` | Lightweight image using external services for embeddings, document extraction, and voice | | `:cuda` | Open WebUI with CUDA acceleration | | `:ollama` | Open WebUI bundled with Ollama | | `:dev` | Latest development build | Add these options to `docker run` before the image name as needed: | Option | Purpose | | ---------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `-e OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://your-ollama-server:11434` | Connect to Ollama on another server | | `-e OPENAI_API_KEY=your_secret_key` | Set your OpenAI API key | | `-e HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1` | Disable Hugging Face model downloads for offline use | | `--gpus all` | Enable Nvidia GPU access for `:cuda` or `:ollama`; requires the Nvidia Container Toolkit | See the [Docker installation guide](https://docs.openwebui.com/getting-started/quick-start/) for setup instructions and configuration options. #### Desktop App [Download the native desktop app](https://github.com/open-webui/desktop) for macOS, Windows, and Linux. [Read the docs →](https://docs.openwebui.com/getting-started/) ### Ecosystem - [Open Terminal](https://github.com/open-webui/open-terminal) / [Terminals (Enterprise)](https://github.com/open-webui/terminals): The action layer that turns Open WebUI into a full agent harness, with enterprise orchestration for per-user workspaces. - [Knowledge Base Sync (oikb)](https://github.com/open-webui/oikb): Mirror folders, repos, buckets, and wikis into Open WebUI Knowledge Bases with incremental sync. - [Open WebUI Computer](https://github.com/open-webui/computer): Your computer in any browser: files, editor, terminal, git, and optional AI agents, running on your real machine. See the [ecosystem documentation](https://docs.openwebui.com/ecosystem/) for details. ### Troubleshooting and Updates See the [troubleshooting guide](https://docs.openwebui.com/troubleshooting/) for connection issues and the [updating guide](https://docs.openwebui.com/getting-started/updating) to update your installation. ### Documentation See the [docs](https://docs.openwebui.com/) for configuration and usage, and the [roadmap](https://docs.openwebui.com/roadmap/) for planned work. For Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and other setups, see the [installation docs](https://docs.openwebui.com/getting-started/). ### Support [Open an issue](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/issues) or [start a discussion](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/discussions). Find us on [Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/OpenWebUI/), [X](https://x.com/OpenWebUI), and [Discord](https://discord.gg/5rJgQTnV4s). ### Security Report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/security). Security reports are accepted only through GitHub. ### Star History #### License Includes code under the Open WebUI License, which requires preserving the Open WebUI branding, and prior contributions under their original licenses.
